claims.nodeLabel: ARVP (arvp.co.uk), the Flux Liner project site
claims.text: The site names no owner, author or organisation anywhere on the pages opened. Its footer gives only 'Email: Flux_liners@icloud.com', a 'Privacy Policy' link and 'Site by Blueqube' pointing at https://blueqube.org.uk . It carries no copyright notice and no licence statement of any kind on the FLUX 1988, TECH or SHOP pages.

claims.nodeLabel: ARVP (arvp.co.uk), the Flux Liner project site
claims.text: The renders are sold. The shop lists three products, 'ARV_2009', 'Fluxliner full colour' and 'Fluxliner Illustrated', at 30.00 each, with no licence terms stated.

edges.label: Publishes a 3D reconstruction of the claimed craft and sells prints of it
edges.note: The reconstruction is the site operator's own work and is built from secondary material: 'I rebuilt it from the ground up, using measurements from the original sketches and information provided by Mark in his talks and videos'. The page states the original drawing could not be obtained. Prints are sold at 30.00 each with no licence terms stated.
